class.name: VECSNetworkSync
class.brief_description:
Central network coordinator: binds a world to a sync strategy and exposes the RPC transport.
网络同步中枢：把世界绑定到同步策略并暴露 RPC 传输层。
class.description:
[b]VECSNetworkSync[/b] connects one [VECSWorld] to a [VECSSyncStrategy] (default: [VECSSnapshotReplication]) and drives replication. On the server, call [method tick] each frame; the strategy spawns networked entities, pushes dirty fields as deltas, despawns destroyed entities and periodically broadcasts a full state for reconciliation.
Transport is Godot's MultiplayerAPI (RPC); for testing, connect two nodes with [method set_direct_peer] to deliver packets in-process without a network.
[b]VECSNetworkSync[/b] 把一个 [VECSWorld] 连接到 [VECSSyncStrategy]（默认：[VECSSnapshotReplication]）并驱动复制。在服务器上每帧调用 [method tick]；策略会生成网络实体、以增量推送脏字段、销毁实体的反生成，并定期广播全量状态以对账。
传输层是 Godot 的 MultiplayerAPI（RPC）；测试时用 [method set_direct_peer] 连接两个节点，即可在进程内传递数据包而无需网络。

method.name: bind_world
method.description:
Binds this sync node to [param world]. Registers an observer that forwards component events to the strategy and seeds the strategy from the current world contents.
把该同步节点绑定到 [param world]。注册一个观察者，把组件事件转发给策略，并从当前世界内容为策略播种。

method.name: get_direct_peer
method.description:
Returns the in-process peer set with [method set_direct_peer].
返回用 [method set_direct_peer] 设置的进程内对等节点。

method.name: get_session_id
method.description:
Returns the current replication session id. Packets carrying an older session id are ignored.
返回当前复制会话 id。携带更旧会话 id 的数据包会被忽略。

method.name: get_strategy
method.description:
Returns the active sync strategy.
返回当前生效的同步策略。

method.name: is_server
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if this node is configured as the authoritative server.
若该节点被配置为权威服务器则返回 [code]true[/code]。

method.name: request_full_state
method.description:
Immediately broadcasts a full-state snapshot to every connected peer (reconciliation).
立即向每个已连接的对等节点广播全量状态快照（对账）。

method.name: reset
method.description:
Unregisters the world observer and resets the strategy's tracked state.
注销世界观察者并重置策略的跟踪状态。

method.name: set_direct_peer
method.description:
Sets an in-process peer for testing: packets are delivered directly to [param peer] instead of going through the RPC layer.
为测试设置进程内对等节点：数据包直接送达 [param peer]，而不经过 RPC 层。

method.name: set_server
method.description:
Sets whether this node acts as the authoritative server.
设置该节点是否作为权威服务器。

method.name: set_session_id
method.description:
Sets the replication session id; packets from older sessions are dropped.
设置复制会话 id；更旧会话的数据包会被丢弃。

method.name: set_strategy
method.description:
Swaps in a custom [VECSSyncStrategy] implementation. The new strategy is seeded from the current world.
换入自定义的 [VECSSyncStrategy] 实现。新策略会从当前世界播种。

method.name: tick
method.description:
Drives the strategy once per frame with [param delta] seconds. On the server this sends spawns, deltas, despawns and periodic reconciliations.
以 [param delta] 秒每帧驱动一次策略。在服务器上会发送生成、增量、反生成与定期对账。
